description_en: Invoke ChangeChatAgentStatus to modify the Live Support status

kebab_example: aliyun aiccs change-chat-agent-status --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d94d --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name account1 --biz-method requestLogout --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeChatAgentStatus

parameters.help_en: Unique ID for the customer request. Used for idempotency validation. You can generate it using UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID. You can obtain it from the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。可在智能联络中心控制台上获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The target online status to switch to. Currently, only requestLogout (request offline) is supported
parameters.help_zh: 想要切换到的在线状态。目前支持requestLogout （申请离线）
parameters.name: method
